summary: 英国的育儿分工究竟由先天性别差异还是社会期待塑造？作者检验问卷研究与文化解释，考察父亲更深参与照料时遇到的压力，并用育儿时间的变化观察平等进展。
logic: 分析父亲参与育儿的阻力
用跨年代时间数据看变化

paragraphs.brief: 他的团队对日产婴儿的实验，以及发现男婴对吊着的玩具和女婴对脸的观察时间更长，自他出版他的书以来，媒体一再引用。
sentences: When Simon Baron-Cohen recently published a book, The Essential Difference, in which he claimed that the female brain is predominantly hard-wired for empathy, the male brain is predominantly hard-wired for understanding and building systems, he caught the mood of the moment.
当Simon Baron-Cohen最近出版了一本书，《基本差异》，书中声称女性大脑主要是为同情而硬结的，男性大脑主要是为理解和建设系统而硬结，他抓住了当时的情绪。

His team's experiments on day-old babies, and the finding that the male babies looked for longer at a hanging toy and the female babies longer at a face, has been repeatedly cited in the press since his book's publication.
他的团队对日产婴儿的实验，以及发现男婴对吊着的玩具和女婴对脸的观察时间更长，自他出版他的书以来，媒体一再引用。
However, Elizabeth Spelke is one expert who is sceptical about whether this experiment deserves such attention.
然而，伊丽莎白·斯佩尔克是一位专家，他对这项实验是否值得关注持怀疑态度。
This is one isolated experiment, she says.
她说这是一个孤立的实验
'Its findings fly in the face of dozens of studies on similar aspects of cognition carried out on young babies over decades.
数十年来对幼童的认知也有类似的研究发现这些都非常明显
It is astonishing how much this one study has been cited, when the many studies that show no difference between the sexes, or a difference in the other direction, are ignored.'
令人惊讶的是，当许多研究表明男女没有差别，或者在另一方向没有差别时，人们就引用了多少。

paragraphs.brief: 男爵-Cohen的另一项主要研究是通过收集和审查成年人根据自己行为填写的调查问卷的答复：即杂志读者熟知的测验。
sentences: One of Baron-Cohen's other main studies was conducted by collecting and examining responses to questionnaires completed by adults on their own behaviour: the sort of quiz well known to readers of magazines.
男爵-Cohen的另一项主要研究是通过收集和审查成年人根据自己行为填写的调查问卷的答复：即杂志读者熟知的测验。
The answers recorded in such cases will reflect differences formed by cultural assumptions and socialisation: it is hard to see what they tell us about innate differences.
在这些情况下记录的答案将反映文化假设和社会化所产生的差异：很难看到它们告诉我们什么是内在差异。

Nevertheless, they have become a fashionable reference point, and recently Princess Anne, patron of Women into Science and Engineering, gave a speech in which she quoted Baron-Cohen's research as proof that six out of ten men have a systemising brain.
然而，它们已成为时尚的参照点，最近，妇女进入科学和工程的赞助者安妮公主发表演讲，她引用了男爵-科亨的研究，以证明每10个男人中就有6个拥有系统化的大脑。
This kind of science has passed into everyday culture, often outrunning the intentions of those who did the original work.
这种科学已经传入日常文化中，往往超越了那些做原始工作的人的意图。

paragraphs.brief: 社会期望与青年男女有很大不同，在今天的英国，期望在某些方面比10或20年前更为普遍。
sentences: Social expectations play heavily with young men and women, and expectations are in some ways more conventional in Britain today than they were ten or 20 years ago.
社会期望与青年男女有很大不同，在今天的英国，期望在某些方面比10或20年前更为普遍。
It is particularly when they have children that women find out how society reinforces traditional expectations of their behaviour.
特别是在妇女有子女时，妇女才能发现社会如何强化对其行为的传统期望。

They discover that many pressures - including the work schedule of their male partner and the expectations of his employer that it should be maintained - make it hard to combine work and home without giving their paid work a lower priority than their male colleagues do.
他们发现，许多压力，包括男性伴侣的工作时间安排和雇主对应保持这种时间安排的期望，使得在不把有酬工作放在男性同事的次要位置的情况下将工作与家庭结合起来变得十分困难。
In such a context, the claims about males' greater power to systemise and compete only serve to put further pressure on women.
在这种情况下，声称男性有更大的权力进行系统化和竞争只会给妇女带来进一步的压力。

paragraphs.brief: 这种压力对男子同样强烈，迫使他们继续采用传统生活方式。
sentences: The pressures are equally powerful on men to continue in a traditional lifestyle.
这种压力对男子同样强烈，迫使他们继续采用传统生活方式。

Some educationalists argue that among young men the concern that they might appear 'feminine' is higher than ever and may even hold back educational achievement, since studying is often seen as girlish.
有些教育家认为，在青年男子中，她们可能显得“女性化”的担忧比以往任何时候要高，甚至可能阻碍她们的教育成就，因为学习往往被视为女孩。
In later life, the drive to competitiveness in the workplace is mythologised as being tied to high levels of masculinity.
在后世，工作场所竞争力的驱动力被神话化为与高度的男性气概联系在一起。

Men are also told that high achievers attract more women, even though evidence shows that as women slowly become more equal at work, they begin to care less about the economic status of potential partners.
男子还被告知，高成就者吸引更多的妇女，尽管有证据表明，随着妇女在工作上逐渐变得平等，她们开始不太关心潜在伙伴的经济地位。

paragraphs.brief: 男子往往无法作出更深入家庭生活的选择，尤其是无法照顾子女，因为她们感到自己没有地位。
sentences: Men are often held back from making the choice to move deeper into domestic life, and in particular childcare, feeling that it lacks status.
男子往往无法作出更深入家庭生活的选择，尤其是无法照顾子女，因为她们感到自己没有地位。

While the gains in making a social revolution were clear for women - they could gain status and income by moving beyond the home - the gains in the parallel social revolution are harder for men to see, since it will involve them in losing status and income.
虽然妇女显然在进行社会革命方面有所收获——她们可以通过走出家庭而获得地位和收入——但男子更难以看到平行社会革命的成果，因为这将使她们失去地位和收入。
The idea that men are naturally less empathetic also produces feelings of fatalism about their role.
认为男人天生不那么冷漠也会产生对自己角色的宿命感
Yet there is much evidence to show that even being empathetic and good at parenting is a learned behaviour.
然而，有许多证据表明，即使是同情和善于为人父母，也是一种有学识的行为。

paragraphs.brief: 的确，正如语言学家史蒂文·平克所指出的，在我们的文化中，妇女更愿意响应她们子女的呼声，但除了实践和社会化之外，没有什么可说的。
sentences: It is true that, as the linguist Steven Pinker noted, in our culture women respond more readily to their children's cries, but there is nothing to say that this is down to anything other than practice and socialisation.
的确，正如语言学家史蒂文·平克所指出的，在我们的文化中，妇女更愿意响应她们子女的呼声，但除了实践和社会化之外，没有什么可说的。
In a culture where most men return to work straight after the birth of their children, it would be extraordinary if they did manage to remain as alert to their needs as women who remain at home.
在大多数男子在子女出生后直接返回工作岗位的文化中，如果她们能够像留在家中的妇女一样，对自己的需要保持警觉，那将是非凡的。
In one test carried out with teenagers, although girls said that they liked children more than boys said they did, when left alone with a crying infant, their responses were no different.
在对青少年进行的一次测试中，虽然女孩说她们比男孩更喜欢孩子，但是她们独自与哭泣的婴儿呆在一起时，她们的反应也是一样的。
Women can testify to the fact that parenting is a tricky, complicated process, not always a natural, easy role.
妇女可以证明，养育子女是一个棘手、复杂的过程，并不总是自然而易得的角色。

paragraphs.brief: 四分之三的年轻人告诉民意测验员说，在英国，父亲在生育后可以休假的时间太短，即陪产假。
sentences: However, while the definite trend of a decade ago is no longer evident, the movement towards equality has not completely stalled.
然而，虽然十年前的明确趋势已不再明显，但实现平等的进程并没有完全停止。
A more equal sharing of childcare and even domestic labour is still desired by many men as well as women.
许多男子和妇女仍然希望更平等地分担儿童保育甚至家务。
Nearly three-quarters of young British men say that if it were financially possible they would like to stay at home to look after their families.
将近四分之三的英国青年男子说，如果经济上可行，他们愿意留在家里照顾家人。
And three-quarters of young men tell pollsters that the amount of time fathers are allowed to take off work after a birth - paternity leave - is too short in Britain.
四分之三的年轻人告诉民意测验员说，在英国，父亲在生育后可以休假的时间太短，即陪产假。
The government is therefore proposing more equal policies on maternity/paternity leave, knowing that the pressure is still forwards rather than backwards.
因此，政府提出更平等的产假/陪产假政策，因为知道压力仍然在向前，而不是向后。
And remember that in Britain, young men in full-time work spend about an hour a day looking after their children.
记住在英国全职工作的年轻人每天要花大约一小时照顾孩子

That may sound paltry, but not compared to the 15 minutes they spent 30 years ago: if the time went on increasing fourfold every 30 years, equal partnership would become a reality for their grandchildren.
这可能听起来微不足道，但与他们30年前的15分钟相比却并非如此：如果时间每30年增加四倍，平等伙伴关系将变成他们的孙子孙女的现实。

items.en: a possible argument for poor academic performance in young boys
items.zh: 男孩学业成绩不佳的可能理由
items.why: D 段说有些男孩担心学习显得“女性化”，这种社会期待可能压低学业表现，给出了男孩成绩欠佳的一种解释。

items.en: a comparison between fathers’ and mothers’ reactions to babies’ demands
items.zh: 比较父母对婴儿需求的反应
items.why: F 段比较父母对年幼孩子需求的反应，并联系父亲通常较快返工、母亲较常留家照顾的社会安排。

items.en: a reference to a change in women’s interest in men’s earning power
items.zh: 提到妇女对男子赚钱能力的兴趣的改变
items.why: D 段指出，女性在职场地位逐渐平等后，对潜在伴侣经济地位的重视程度下降，符合题干所说的偏好变化。

items.en: a reference to a study on infant behaviour
items.zh: 提及对婴儿行为的研究
items.why: A 段报告新生儿实验：男婴注视悬挂玩具更久，女婴注视人脸更久。研究对象和行为指标都与题干相符。

items.en: a prediction that there will be more involvement of men in childcare
items.zh: 预测男子将更多地参与儿童保育工作
items.why: G 段把过去几十年父亲育儿时间的增长外推到下一代，推测若趋势延续，孙辈可能实现平等分担育儿。

items.en: a reference to analysis using a popular self-assessment method
items.zh: 提及使用大众自评方法的分析
items.why: B 段写研究者分析成年人自填的行为问卷，并把这种形式比作杂志读者熟悉的小测验，符合“常见自我评估方法”。

items.en: results of an experiment on adolescents’ reactions to young babies
items.zh: 青少年对幼儿的反应实验的结果
items.why: F 段的实验让青少年与哭泣的婴儿单独相处。尽管女孩自称更喜欢小孩，实验中男孩和女孩的实际反应没有差别。

items.en: What is Elizabeth Spelke’s reaction to Baron-Cohen’s experiment?
items.zh: 伊丽莎白·斯佩尔克如何看待巴伦-科恩的实验？
correct: She is doubtful whether it merits the notice it has been given.
她怀疑这项实验是否值得受到如此多的关注。

items.en: According to the writer, why do mothers often put childcare above career demands?
items.zh: 作者认为，为什么母亲常把照顾孩子放在事业需求之前？
correct: Few allowances are made for fathers to reduce their working hours.
父亲想缩短工作时间时，往往很难得到相应的照顾或安排。

items.en: What does the writer suggest about women as parents in paragraph F?
items.zh: 作者在 F 段暗示，女性为人母时面临什么情况？
correct: They have to work at mastering the skills of motherhood.
她们也必须通过努力才能掌握育儿技巧。

items.en: Staying at home would in fact mean accepting a considerable drop in pay and in ________.
items.zh: 实际上，留在家里意味着要接受薪酬和 ________ 双双大幅下降。
items.why: 题干中的 drop in pay 对应原文 losing income。空格与 pay 并列，原文另一个损失是 status。所以填 status。

items.en: The conventional notion that men are not as ________ as women may also lead men to experience a certain sense of resignation about their traditional place in society.
items.zh: 传统上，人们认为男性不像女性那样 ________，这也可能使男性有些无奈地接受其传统社会角色。
items.why: 回到对应内容“认为男人天生不那么冷漠也会产生对自己角色的宿命感”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: However, it is interesting to note that the majority of young men in the UK say that the statutory time permitted for ________ is inadequate.
items.zh: 值得注意的是，英国大多数年轻男性都表示，法律允许的 ________ 时间不够长。
items.why: 回到对应内容“四分之三的年轻人告诉民意测验员说，在英国，父亲在生育后可以休假的时间太短，即陪产假”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Influence is thus being exerted on the ________ to review the existing provision.
items.zh: 因此，________ 正受到压力，需要重新审视现行安排。
items.why: 题干中的 Influence is thus being exerted on…对应原文 the pressure is still forwards。能够 review the existing provision 的主体是 government,原文也明确说政府正在提出新政策。所以填 government。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

pairs: 学业表现不佳／阻碍学业成就
兴趣发生变化，在这里指开始没那么在意
the economic status of potential partners
挣钱能力／潜在伴侣的经济地位
分析，在这里指收集并检查答复
questionnaires completed by adults on their own behaviour
自我评估，通过填写关于自身行为的问卷完成
doubtful whether it merits the notice it has been given
about whether this experiment deserves such attention
怀疑这项实验是否值得如此关注
giving their paid work a lower priority
把育儿放在工作之前／降低工作的优先级
在这段谈论时间的语境中指时间太短
the amount of time fathers are allowed to take off work
points: A 段报告新生儿实验：男婴注视悬挂玩具更久，女婴注视人脸更久。研究对象和行为指标都与题干相符。
题干中的 Influence is thus being exerted on…对应原文 the pressure is still forwards。能够 review the existing provision 的主体是 government,原文也明确说政府正在提出新政策。所以填 government。
clauses: However, Elizabeth Spelke is one expert ….
“who is sceptical about whether this experiment deserves such attention”修饰前面的 expert。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 who 时，回看 expert，再把修饰信息接回主句。
… - they could gain status and income by moving beyond the home - the gains in the parallel social revolution are harder for men to see, since it will involve them in losing status and income.
连接词 while 引出“While the gains in making a social revolution were clear for women”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
